rows.claim: Option 2 would stop the 3 running jobs.
rows.evidence: The only tool output on this is the 409 error: "scale-down blocked: 3 jobs are still running (override with --force; requires approval)". It shows that 3 jobs are running and that --force overrides the block. It does not say that forcing would stop those jobs. The agent inferred that consequence; the output doesn't confirm it and doesn't contradict it either.
